review_description: All 3 quoting companies were prompt and professional with their response. I chose green valley Solar as the price was competitive, the proposed system was of good quality and research into the quote included climbing onto my roof for a quality check. The installation was completed as agreed with excellent customer service and helpful advice and support in understanding how to monitor the system. Highly recommended.

Thanks to Solar Quotes we received two quotes within a week of you notifying the installers.  We made our selection in the following week after discussions with both installers.  We identified our issues with our existing panels & Mike proposed some other work as well. We confirmed our arrangements with Green Valley Solar and arrangements were agreed for installation on 2nd August.  It was approved & activated by our distributor Ausnet on 7 August.Mike was very good to deal with and did everything we expected based on my lessons learned from reading plenty of Solar Quotes material.If only every project around the home could be as well organised & managed.

I've recently had my 5kw Jinko/Fronius system installed,  it's still early days but from what i've experienced so far. Could not be happier, even during a cloudy Melbourne winter!I originally requested quotes from solarquotes.com.au and received two calls from other retailers. One was brilliant during the sales call, though doing some digging and reading reviews, the installs didn't leave them with the best reputation, the other company couldn't be less interested. Not comfortable with either of those companies, I looked for a local company on the solarquotes website and got in contact.Mike was awesome from the beginning. He's the business owner and completes the quotes/installs himself (with help from Aaron). He's really friendly, honest, wasn't pushy, and happy to answer all my questions, gave me options and clearly explained the pros/cons of certain products.The quote was itemised (which I really appreciated, other quotes i'd received or seen were rolled up packages). The guys came out and did a measure and look at my roof, talked through the quote/products again and about a week later they came out to do the install - the install looks amazing - really tidy compared to others i've seen, they left my garage where they installed the inverter neater than it was when they came in! They also got me all set up on the app to check how much energy is being generated and sent to the grid etc before they left.Mike has touched base after the inspector came, letting me know when the paperwork had been submitted to my energy retailer and kept me updated throughout the whole process.I can already see my cost savings (especially with electric ducted heating) and really happy with my decision to go with Green Valley Solar. Would definitely recommend Mike/Aaron to anyone who's looking for a trustworthy, professional/peace of mind install.I'll be getting them back when I add a battery!

The sales and quoting, was easy and not high pressure. Green Valley discussed technical details on request, and explained how it would work,and the costs involved.Installation was very neat and on the time quoted, with very friendly staff.This is the second system I have purchased from Green Valley, an upgrade to a previously installed system and I would recommend them as honest and professional. Very happy customer!Greg Jones - Emerald VIC.
Honest and open advice about the advantages and disantvantages of the available options.
Very good, honest customer service, installation on my review is "not applicable" as the system is to be installed late October 2018

The installation and process of installing our system has been seamless, and Mike has been fantastic at communicating and providing advice and support before, during, and after the installation of our system. His assistance in dealing with our provider and additional paperwork was also greatly appreciated.I would have no hesitation in recommending Mikes services to anyone looking for a cost effective, peace-of-mind solar install.

Of the 3 installers you gave me, only 2 contacted me. The first company were nice enough, a little pushy but okay until I questioned the warranty and quality of the panels and Inverter they were quoting on, then I didn't hear from them again. Mike Phyland from Green Valley Solar was so nice, and was happy for me to do my homework on the panels and inverters. He was honest, friendly and certainly knows his stuff.Everything about him and his team was so professional, I can't fault them.

I highly recommend GreenValley Solar for their excellent service and great customer feedback. Paul and Mike installed the system in a day and were always very happy to answer any questions. I'm glad that I chose them and the solar system is running beautifully.

Mike was a bit slow in responding initially but is clearly very busy because he is very good. He was very accommodating during installation, was timely and actually over delivered on what was originally quoted.No problems so far with the system
Can't speak highly enough of the service, professionalism and knowledge shown by Mike. Extremely pleased we chose him for the jpb.

Very easy to deal with and very knowledgeable electricians. A quality installation at a very competitive price with no hard sell tactics. Everything was very clearly explained and they did exactly what they said they would do when they said they would. Very happy.

Had a 6kw system installed in March after a 2 month search for the right deal. Paul and Mike were just great from the start and easy to deal with. No BS and explained everything I asked with no pressure to buy. They came back to help with the monitoring system hook-up a few times due to my poor wif-fi signal where the invertor was, no charge just part of the service. I would recommend them to anyway in the area.
Top end components at a great price. Superb service. Highly recommended.
Paul, Mick and their team are great. In and out in a day, system works exactly as described, no BS advice and everything as described. Can't fault them, to be honest - highly recommended.

When I contacted Green Valley Mike emailed me heaps of information. He visited my site and spent ages answering my questions and discussing the options available to me. On the installation day he arrived on time with this apprentice - he does his own installations. They worked until bad weather forced them to stop. He returned the next morning to complete the installation, which has worked faultlessly since.
Highly recommend Green Valley Solar to anyone wishing to install a solar system!

Mike was great to work with, very friendly and knowledgeable. Gave great advice on what types of systems would suit us best and then let us make the decision. Wasn't at all pushy. He was punctual with the install. Let us know exactly how long it would take and he was right.

Green Valley Solar worked around what panels and inverter we wanted to use. Unlike other companies who would try and push their preferred products. Really liked that the person who gave the quote did the installation and commissioning instead of a subcontractor. They did an excellent job.

We dealt with Mike throughout the whole process and he was great. It proved to be very helpful to have an electrician quoting rather than a sales rep. Mike could accurately assess our meter, fuses and wiring and include costs for any extra work required in the quote. Whereas the quote we got from another company advised in the fine print that meter wiring mods, etc. could be an extra unspecified amount.Mike proved to be cooperative and helpful as I changed my mind regarding the size of system multiple times during the quotation fase.The installation was carried out competently and carefully and once completed, Mike looked after all the certification paperwork as well. Highly recommended.
It was good to make first contact with the installer, not a sales person.

Green Valley Solar were a great company to work with. They were very friendly & very helpful in tailoring a system to suit our needs.We ended up getting 6.2kw of Jinko panels (split North / West) and a 5kw Fronius Inverter.Installation was very smooth, they were done in less than a day.We've had the system for about 5 months and so far its worked perfectly.

Paul sent through a quote with various options, he followed up with a call, then we arranged a visit to our home.I got 2 other quotes, which were competitive, but Paul was spot on and very informative.I took a few weeks to do some homework & after letting Paul know they were successful, the install date was set for 3 weeks later.Paul & team turned up on time and had the system installed by 3.I have been very happy with the system & am just waiting for the system to be signed off and then connecten to my Energy supplier.

We received quotes after inspection which we requested by Green Valley Solar and another. The 3rd company I had to chase 3 times and when they finally provided a quote it was only from google maps.  We decided on Green Valley Solar which best suited our budget.
The guys at Green Valley have been awesome !

My experience with Paul from Green Valley was fantastic. Very professional, on the initial visit he explained everything fully answering all of my questions. They arrived on the agreed day and time and had finished by mid afternoon, cleaned up all their rubbish and left me with a great looking job, all straight and square. All the paperwork and testing was arranged by Paul and three weeks later we're fully operational.

Paul Johnson provided excellent data with the quote. We also had a long discussion about the system and its advantages.Installation was on time and went very smoothly.So far (installed 23.11.17) all going well.Would certainly recommend Green Valley Solar.
The person who installed the product was the person I dealt with from the very beginning.  Not a sales person. That was a huge plus for me as he actually knew what he was talking about.

Paul, Mike and Window were terrific from the start. They are all electricians with heaps of solar experience and it showed during the quote, discussions on the best solution, install and even afterwards dealing with high voltage in our street and AusNet. Paul simply can't do enough for you, I've emailed him a few times about the street voltage issue and he always calls me back the same day. The install appears to be very high quality, no skimping on cheap mounts, conduit etc and it's all very neatly and elegantly done, Fronius Primo inverter and Winaico panels under $7k with a new switchboard included (old one was too small). We love our new system and we've already cut our import by more than half in a household that averages 22kWh/day over the year (home office). We have also already recommended the guys at Green Valley Solar to several friends. I doubt you could go wrong with Green Valley.

Paul and the Team did a perfect installation zero concerns about the install . he took the time to show us how to use the Fronius website and gave us some tips on saving power I.E setting the spa on timer to minimise power usage from the grid.He took a lot of time to explain a lot of questions I asked with zero sales pitch which was refreshing. Based on his opinion we have overclocked the panels  to maximise the benefits of the system.He has done everything he said he would do now just waiting on our power supply company to do their thing.Thanks again Paul and the team for making this so pain free it was almost a pleasure paying for it :)

The installer I chose was a wonderful man, giving me information to look up and even helped me to fix a meter problem that we didn't even know we had! He physically came to my property to have a look and then spent 2 hours making sure I knew what I was getting. Couldn't recommend them highly enough!

Honest, professional, punctual and easy to deal with, not many tradies have all these qualities, but Green valley solar seem to have them all coveredIf you are looking for a good quality, value for money system, I wouldhighly recommed themGreen valley solar installed a 5kw system with winiaco panels and fronius inverter,and installed it for the powerwall2 that I had ordered to be retro fitted when itwas delivered, the whole system is now intalled and up and running....perfectlyBoth the electical inspector and the Tesla installer commented on how wellGVS had done their work and set up and laid out everything for a very easyinstallation of the powerwallI dont often write glowing recommendations, but thought I must in this casethanks again Mike

Paul at Green Valley Solar was very prepared to answer any questions and to help separate the fact from the fiction being peddled by many operators. He is passionate about what he does, and is very keen to ensure his customers understand what they are purchasing, and will be satisfied with the end product.  He also provided many valuable links to reputable sites that allowed me to confirm what was being said.  This made making the decision to run with him much easier.The system was installed quickly, the level of workmanship was high, and the system is functioning as we expected.

After suffering through high pressure salespeople from other companies I found the solarquotes web site and was pleasantly surprised by the no nonsense approach from the installers provided by Finn.Paul from Green Valley visited my home and explained what he thought would be the best solution for me and left me with a few options to think about.I did a bit more research and decided to proceed with them.The team of Paul, Mark and Aaron were great and the installation was hassle free and the system passed inspection with no issues.I have real time monitoring and am impressed with the output from the system.I'm now waiting for the power company to update the meter and start getting a payback.
Very knowledgeable company. I had conflicting comments about how to handle my 2-phase supply - GVS was spot on.  Work done quickly and as stated. Highly recommend Green Valley Solar.

Paul was very friendly and experienced. He was detailed and able to explain technically and logically with his recommendations and products. Together with his team, the installation was done professionally and cleanly and to completion of submission paperwork to our energy supplier swiftly.

I was happy with all three companies that quoted after entering my information into solarquotes.  In the end I chose Green Valley Solar.  They were the closest, and super helpful, and I liked the advice that they gave.  They were great guys!  The system was installed quickly and is performing well.

The Green Valley representative called same day as my inquiry and spent some time explaining what components he used and the reasons. He lives locally and was able to come next day to look at the shed for the solar panels and explained how the system would need to be installed. Technically he was able to answer all the aspects that I was interested in and provided data sheets for the panels, inverter and mounting. He was able to provide a quotation that day that was within the range of my expectations. He also provide links to videos of solar systems that he had repaired and the reasons for the failures which were mainly related to the quality of the installation work. He was also able to show photographs of some of his installations and the performance results. He gave a date of about two weeks ahead that he said he could do the install and he completed that on the day promised. He then went through some of the system details re cut-off switches etc and system performance monitoring.So all up he explained the intended system very well, provided an acceptable quotation, completed the work as promised within a very reasonable time, his work was very neat and professional and to date the system is working very well. So five stars!

Paul is very approachable and answers all your questions.They started on time and were done in a day with a very professional job.Additional Comment 15/07/17:Whist I have no problem with their expert installation the same cannot be said for their office procedures.I would advise anyone getting solar panels fitted to withhold some of the payment to the installer until they hear from their electricity retailer.I find that I am now in the position of pumping power into the grid for which I will see no effect to my bill for 2 months.I have spoken to a few other people who have had panels fitted and they have had the same problem regardless of the supplier.So buyer beware.

Great people, on time, immediately to work, over the top service on all paper work , returned to check overall and explain inverter readings with info supplied to computer via smart meter in power box.

Green Valley Solar were excellent and very professional. They have a good experience and were willing to talk about what went where and why.Energy Assist were good and in the end it was a close call. But I preferred the technical acumen of the green valley solar. Energy assist actually offered a closer item to what I wanted, but the equipment batteries were only just on the market and I did not want to be a guinea pig for a new supplier.

We were totally lost at the start of the solar "journey" - didn't know what to look out for or who to turn to.  Solar quotes gave us plenty of easy to understand information and put us in touch with some very good operators.

So far everything is going exactly as planned.  Delivery/installation was done exactly as promised.  Paul took the time to explain the system operation and to manage the paperwork.  I would highly recommend this company based on my experience so far.
Very happy with the quality of workmanship, absolutely top job very neat.

Installed 11 Jan 17.  Energy Vic inspected system 18 Jan 17 and advised me installation was OK. Have left messages for Supplier to contact me re difficulty logging onto the Fronius website - still waiting for a reply!

Paul Johnston was very easy to deal with, he arrived on time, his crew worked hard from 8 until 4 with one short break.  The install was neat, exactly where we discussed.  Paul guided me through the system, made sure I could log online, registered all the components and serials for warranty on the spot via his tablet, set up the account, sent in the paperwork to book the inspection and the paperwork to the Electricity company and supplier.  I must say, the whole experience was smooth, no hassles, didn't need to chase any party, they all rang me in due course to arrange their visits (inspection, programming the meter etc).  On a personal note Paul took the time just after the quote to answer my emails and my questions, he came out to look and explain in detail my options, he offered 2 competitive quote and gave me enough information to go and research further.  I did not choose the cheap option but rather went for a system and panels from a good source (ie. lots of good reviews).  I recommended Green Valley Solar to a mate since the installation.  I am very happy with the system and its performance especially the online monitoring tool.  It is so easy even my wife checks it during the day.

Local and Victorian with their suppliers nearby. Not sales people but tradies walking the talk. On time, explained about 90% and much more than others. Genuine, reasonable size to expect continued support if needed, well recommended by other users. (In discussion they let slip without knowing another big user whom I knew well. They hadn't said to call them but I did. this confirmed my decision.)  Solargain didn't send anyone and sounded not interested over the phone, of your suggested Nicholls group had better salesperson by far as he was a tradie not a sales and best system.Thans for your time and effort and I would definitely recommend you look at Green valley for anyone in the melbourne area, even though they are based in Silvan

Paul took the time to come out and spend as long as it took to explain my options.  It was a learning experience so it helped when someone had the patience to answer your questions.  The choice in the end came down to the company installing and the technology they chose to put forward.  To me this made the decision very easy regardless of the price.  On the day they worked very hard and did a professional job.  I am very happy with the results and will recommend them in the future to my work colleagues and friends.
I found Green Valley Solar excellent. They answered all of my questions and were neat and tidy, quick and efficient.I would recommend them to anyone else.

Following on my phone call, Mike from Green Valley Solar turned up at my house after having had a look at my location on internet. He explained how it all works. Difference between panels inverters and more importantly an informed local knowledge of power delivery in the area ( power fluctuation ) and which inverter will cope with these conditions. He had a look at my meter box, discussed emplacement of panels, installation etc, very thorough.I also liked the fact that Mike is a qualified electrician and not a salesman. No sales BS, straight to the point.On the agreed day Mike and business partner ( also electrician ) plus apprentice arrived on time, got to work, the installation got inspected the same day and by 4.30 pm the system was operational even though problems came up during the replacement of an electrical cable as I had the panels installed on my shed and the cable to the meter had to be upgraded. The paperwork all taken care of by Mike's partner.The quoted price is what I paid. The service was impeccable.I did a lot of research on internet reading reviews after reviews of solar systems businesses and it is depressing. A friend of mine who had solar installed a few years ago told me that it took 6 months before his installation got inspected and it took many, many phone calls to his electricity supplier.I have no problem in recommending Mike and Paul. I also switched to PowerShop, great service.
Great Bunch of blokes .Highly recommended

We highly recommend Green Valley Solar. The staff are extremely knowledgeable on all facets of solar and honest in their dealings with us from quote through to aftermarket service. We sourced over 10 Solar companies for quotes (both large and small companies) and they were the best by far.Mike created a Solar system which suited our needs, used high end panels and inverter and was the best value for money out of any of the companies looked into.Mike looked at what we required in a system, visually inspected the roof in person prior to sending a quote, unlike many other companies who used salesmen (not A grade electricians) to sell one size fits all packages that they sized up on our roof using a morning Google Earth picture. He was able to create a system that utilised the sun from dawn to dusk as opposed to some companies who were only concerned with maximising energy creation in the middle of the day (great if you were going to receive 60 cents/kWh). Mike was able to answer all our questions and put our minds well and truly at ease.Mike, Paul and their apprentice's work was impeccable. They were methodical in their execution and created a neat, well finished system that was signed off on the day.Once completed, they took us over the system (Fronius Primo Inverter), setting up the WiFi for us and completing all paperwork on the day to get our system making money. Only thing left for us to do was enjoy the free electricity.We will have no hesitation in going with Green Valley Solar when we next require a system installed.Thanks Mike and the team at Green Valley Solar.

Paul from Green Valley Solar firstly spent over an hour with me on the phone, discussing various systems and the different technologies. He then came to my house and inspected the roof. He discussed the placement of the panels and inverter. The installation was completed within a day. The standard of work was very high. Everything has been meticulously installed and looks great! The level of customer service I received from Green Valley Solar was exceptional! They definitely know their stuff, and didn't try to sell me stuff I didn't need or want. I would gladly recommend Paul and the team to anyone. A good, honest, reliable, local expert and installer.
Still waiting on SP Austnet to program meter.

Green Solar is a local Company to us and supporting local businesses is important.That aside, the installers (2) completed the installation in a day and were very efficient and tidy in their work.Their after sales service is spot on as we have issues with our energy supplier.They gave excellent advice along the way and we would recommend them to anyone who is contemplating going solar.

I spent 4 months looking at and thoroughly reviewing detailed Solar Specifications and options and I am glad I finally went with Green Valley Solar. I purchased 4.5kw of Renesola Virtus ii panels that are Tier 1 and locally supported with an SMA inverter. They were easy to deal with and their workmanship and expertise is excellent. The system generates power as intended/predicted - it is winter as I write this review and it generating ok/good amounts of power for this season of short days. We may add batteries and go hybrid one day in the future - when we decide to increase the size or add to the system we will call them.
We also updated the meter box and put LED lights throughout the house.
I found them very helpful in recommending not the biggest but the best value for money. Service before/during and after was excellent.

Would highly recommend Green Valley Solar. They explained everything to me so I knew what was going on. My friend went with someone else and got his done a month before me and is still waiting for them to come out so that he can start claiming the rebate.

Dealing directly with installation electricians rather than salespeople was a very big positive. Easy to deal with, seemed to provide honest information, very good price and no hassle installation. Follow up and ensuring everything was OK even after final payment was excellent. System is working as expected.
